items.label: cp:thm-main
items.explanation: Lean checks the complete implication from ProofContract to finite equidecomposability.

items.label: cp:def-angle-gram
items.explanation: The matrix and Laurent entry are defined; geometric realization by facet normals is outside the algebraic model.

items.label: cp:lem-regge-matrix
items.explanation: All displayed matrix and eigenspace identities are kernel checked.

items.label: cp:thm-regge-input
items.explanation: E1 supplies geometric realization, the action on physical angles and lengths, and volume equality.

items.label: cp:lem-algebraic-regge-involution
items.explanation: Lean checks preservation of the phase hypersurface and involutivity in every commutative group.

items.label: cp:lem-determinant-quadratic
items.explanation: The actual four-by-four determinant and both Laurent coefficient invariances are proved.

items.label: cp:lem-rational-charts
items.explanation: Lean checks both inverse formulas and coverage of the locus where s and w are nonzero; the principal-open scheme isomorphism and function-field language are standard algebraic-geometry consequences not modeled here.

items.label: cp:def-U
items.explanation: The principal-open construction is specified in the manuscript; Lean begins from the resulting typed contract rather than formalizing schemes.

items.label: cp:prop-physical-point-on-chart
items.explanation: Positivity and physical realization are geometric boundary facts; the chart-cover polynomial used in the argument is checked separately.

items.label: cp:prop-fixed-p-cover
items.explanation: All coordinate algebra is checked; scheme-level finite etaleness after discriminant localization is an external standard fact.

items.label: cp:def-face-motive
items.explanation: The formula specifies E2; neither Mathlib nor this project constructs the relative motivic category.

items.label: cp:def-coefficient-contract
items.explanation: The manuscript's linear contract is represented by three explicit Lean structures.

items.label: cp:lem-three-level-framed
items.explanation: Lean proves that the primitive comparison and endpoint vanishing force the coefficient to vanish.

items.label: cp:lem-split-strata
items.explanation: Lean checks the binary matrix identities; global hyperbolic splitting and relative family regularity remain geometric inputs to E2--E4.

items.label: cp:prop-weight-calculation
items.explanation: E3 exposes the graded-piece, strict-heart, primitive-comparison, and arithmetic-vanishing obligations separately.

items.label: cp:lem-regge-tensor-cancellation
items.explanation: Lean proves the half-phase and normalized full-channel identities.

items.label: cp:lem-coproduct-zero
items.explanation: The zero-coproduct conclusion is derived from the checked tensor equality and E4's formula/descent bridge; the typed specialization square then derives fibre-kernel membership.

items.label: cp:thm-relative-defect-zero
items.explanation: Lean combines the coproduct theorem with E3's primitive comparison.

items.label: cp:thm-goncharov-weight-two
items.explanation: E6 supplies c_G on the primitive subgroup and its injectivity.

items.label: cp:lem-spherical-presentations
items.explanation: E6 supplies the injection and E7 separately supplies the presentation equivalence.

items.label: cp:lem-fibre-comparison
items.explanation: E5 names equality of classes with every sign, frame, twist, and duality convention.

items.label: cp:prop-reduced-scissors-zero
items.explanation: Lean checks the endpoint, injectivity, presentation-transport, and rationalization diagram chase.
